user.title: Site power sources
user.description: Select the authoritative Enphase-style site grid and solar production sensors. Power sensors must report W or kW.

data_description.site_grid_power: Signed net grid power. Negative values must mean export and positive values import.
data_description.solar_power: Current solar production used to gate daytime control.

ecoflow.title: EcoFlow Smart Home Panel
ecoflow.description: Select the EcoFlow panel telemetry and charging controls used by the controller.

data_description.shp_grid_power: EcoFlow Smart Home Panel grid-side power sensor.
data_description.shp_home_power: EcoFlow Smart Home Panel home-load power sensor.
data_description.charging_power: EcoFlow number entity that sets charging power per active inverter.

channels.title: Battery channels
channels.description: Map each DPU battery SOC sensor, channel switch, and Force Charge switch. Each entity in a three-channel group must be unique.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure entity mappings
reconfigure.description: Change the Home Assistant entities used by the controller. The integration reloads after a successful reconfiguration.

error.entity_not_found: One or more selected entities are not currently registered in Home Assistant.
error.duplicate_channel_entities: Each SOC, channel-switch, and Force Charge group must contain three different entities.
error.invalid_power_unit: All selected power sensors must report power in W or kW.

abort.already_configured: The EcoFlow Solar Surplus Controller is already configured.

init.title: Controller options
init.description: Keep Operating mode set to Observe while the legacy YAML automation is active. Switch to Control only after disabling the legacy automation so two controllers never write to EcoFlow at the same time.

data.maximum_rate_w: Controller maximum charge rate per inverter

data_description.operating_mode: Observe computes decisions without service calls. Control is allowed to change EcoFlow charging rate and Force Charge switches.
data_description.preferred_import_w: Closed-loop grid target. The v2.3 baseline intentionally prefers a small amount of import.
data_description.start_export_w: Export required before starting a new Force Charge session.
data_description.maximum_rate_w: Software ceiling. The integration also clamps to the number entity's runtime hardware maximum.
data_description.minimum_solar_w: Below this production level the controller will not continue solar-surplus Force Charge.

advanced.title: Advanced controller tuning
advanced.description: These defaults match the deployed v2.3 controller. Change them only when you intentionally want different control behavior.

data.maximum_rate_increase_w: Maximum upward change per fresh grid sample

error.max_rate_below_min: Maximum charge rate must be greater than or equal to the minimum charge rate.
error.moderate_threshold_too_low: Moderate import threshold must be greater than the import-hold upper bound.
error.severe_threshold_too_low: Severe import threshold must be greater than the moderate import threshold.
error.invalid_hysteresis: Each DPU stop threshold must be lower than its corresponding start threshold.
